### Overall Assessment
A competent but incomplete test suite that demonstrates solid RTL fundamentals while missing several explicitly requested test categories (autocomplete, card formatting, session timeout). The Gerri persona is present but underutilized—the legal/compliance angle appears only in framing comments rather than informing the testing strategy itself. The response would benefit from additional depth in validation coverage and stronger character voice throughout.
